verses.text: Shout for joy to the LORD, you who do what is right! It is right for honest people to praise him.
Thank the LORD with the lyre. Make music to him on the ten-stringed harp.
Sing a new song to him. Play skilfully and shout for joy!
The LORD's word is right and true. He is faithful in everything he does.
He loves what is right and fair. The earth is full of the LORD's faithful love.
The skies were made when the LORD spoke. All the stars were made by the breath of his mouth.
He gathers the waters of the sea into a heap. He puts the deep waters into storerooms.
Let the whole earth respect the LORD. Let everyone in the world stand in awe of him.
He spoke, and the world came into being. He gave the command, and it stood firm.
The LORD ruins the plans of the nations. He stops what the peoples intend to do.
But the LORD's plans stand firm forever. What he intends lasts for all generations.
Happy is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he chose as his very own.
The LORD looks down from heaven and sees everyone.
From where he sits on his throne, he watches everyone who lives on earth.
He shapes all their hearts, and he understands everything they do.
No king is saved by the size of his army. No warrior escapes by his great strength.
A horse is no sure way to be saved. Its great strength cannot rescue anyone.
But the LORD watches over those who respect him, those who hope in his faithful love.
He rescues them from death and keeps them alive in times of famine.
We wait for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
Our hearts are glad in him, because we trust in his holy name.
LORD, may your faithful love be with us, because we put our hope in you.
